'''Ezra Du'Re''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] agent who served the [[Cularin Office of Public Safety]]. While investigating a warehouse in [[Tolea Biqua]] on [[Genarius]], she was kidnapped by the gang of the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Gomalo]].
